page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the ecs.r7 family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance features 128 dedicated vCPUs and 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It utilizes KVM virtualization to deliver dedicated compute resources.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be fulfilled via network-attached volumes. To support high-throughput data transfers, the instance is equipped with a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. This high-speed network interface facilitates rapid communication with external storage systems and database clusters.

Given its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.r7.32xlarge is designed for memory-intensive workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data processing pipelines, and large-scale caching layers.
